title: Towards Robust Classroom Attendance: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Face Detection and Recognition Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.22750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Manual attendance methods, such as paper or register-based systems, take a lot of time, can lead to errors, and are easy to falsify. Face recognition is more reliable, but it frequently struggles in classrooms because lighting and other conditions can vary. Face recognition datasets are designed for regulated environments and do not capture the actual challenges found in classrooms. To address this, a new face detection and recognition dataset, the Visage Face dataset, comprising 16,234 face samples, is proposed for the task of face detection and recognition. The photos are taken from different angles and under varying lighting conditions, with students showing a range of expressions, and some faces partly covered to reflect real-life situations. A YOLO-based system is used to detect faces and tested seven advanced face recognition models with thirteen configurations: LVFace, QCFace, FaceLiVTv2, TopoFR, EdgeFace, TransFace, and GhostFa

translated_title: 迈向稳健的课堂考勤：人脸检测与识别模型的综合评估
translated_abstract: 人工考勤方法，如纸质或登记册系统，耗时较长、容易出错且易于伪造。人脸识别更为可靠，但在教室环境中常常表现不佳，因为光照等条件可能多变。现有人脸识别数据集是为受控环境设计的，无法反映教室中的实际挑战。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一个新的用于人脸检测与识别任务的数据集——Visage Face 数据集，包含 16,234 个人脸样本。这些照片从不同角度、在不同光照条件下拍摄，学生呈现出多种表情，部分人脸被部分遮挡，以反映真实场景。系统采用基于 YOLO 的方法进行人脸检测，并以十三种配置测试了七种先进的人脸识别模型：LVFace、QCFace、FaceLiVTv2、TopoFR、EdgeFace、TransFace 和 GhostFa。
tldr: 本文提出了包含16,234个真实课堂场景人脸样本的Visage Face数据集，并基于YOLO检测系统对七种先进人脸识别模型进行了十三种配置的综合评估，以应对课堂考勤中光照多变、表情多样和面部遮挡等实际挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Visage Face dataset with 16,234 face samples captured under real classroom conditions (varying lighting, angles, expressions, and partial occlusion), and comprehensively evaluates seven state-of-the-art face recognition models across thirteen configurations using a YOLO-based detection system for robust classroom attendance.
